ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, company secretary and senior managers against (i) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (CFSP), (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated List, (iii) the OFAC SDN List as a policy benchmark of Cypriot banks and the Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission, and (iv) national designations administered by MOKAS. Enhanced Due Diligence, source of wealth and source of funds verification, and negative media checks are compulsory where a PEP, family member, or close associate is identified, as required by Articles 58–61 of Law 188(I)/2007. Additional counterparty screening applies to commodity flows, suspect cargo, and forfeiture risk under the Cyprus Customs Code and EU Regulation 1013/2006.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver, Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry — Companies Section electronic services portal (name search and reservation module)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names may be registered in English (Latin script) and/or Greek. Where a Greek name is used, a transliterated Latin version of both the distinctive element and the legal suffix must be provided and indexed alongside the Greek form. Names in other scripts must be submitted in full romanized transliteration. The mandatory suffix for a private limited company is 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' in English, or 'Περιορισμένης Ευθύνης' in Greek. Public-company suffixes such as 'Public Limited Company' or 'PLC' are prohibited for a private limited entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may re-file the name application after curing the stated ground, including by attaching prior consent letters from the Attorney-General, Central Bank of Cyprus, Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission, or Insurance Companies Control Service. A formal objection must be submitted in writing to the Registrar of Companies within 30 days of the rejection notice, setting out legal arguments on non-identical and non-deceptive similarity, any regulatory consents, and the corrected proposed name. If the Registrar maintains the rejection, the applicant may institute administrative recourse before the Administrative Court pursuant to Article 146 of the Cyprus Constitution within 75 days of notification, alleging ultra vires, excess of power, or error of law. The original reservation window is not tolled during the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted in pure virtual form. Section 106 of the Companies Law (Cap. 113) requires the registered office to be a physical location in the Republic to which statutory communications may be addressed. A managed or serviced suite providing physical offices, meeting rooms, and staffed reception is acceptable. For the proposed wholesale metal trading activity, the Cyprus commercial substance doctrine further requires central management and control functions, including sales negotiation, contract administration, and invoice and documentary credit processing, to be performed physically in Cyprus; a letterbox arrangement would jeopardize the 12.5% corporate income tax rate claim and create permanent establishment exposure abroad.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified at 30% probability within the first 12 months of active operation for a medium-risk commodity trader. Unannounced inspections may be conducted by MOKAS, the Cyprus Police, the Customs and Excise Department, the Department of Environment under the Waste Management Law (L.185(I)/2011), and the Registrar's inspection officers where commercial substance is questioned. The probability rises to 40–50% if the premises are found uninhabited or lacking documentary evidence of the scrap-copper wire trading activity.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law, Cap. 113 (Cyprus), as amended, especially Sections 5, 6, 10 and 108; transposition of EU Directive 2017/1132. This is the sole company law applying in the Republic and constitutes the mandatory legal basis for incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCORO), Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Nicosia; filings via the electronic e-Companies platform (www.ecompanies.com.cy).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&AA), filed together with the electronic Application for Registration through the DRCORO one-stop shop e-Companies portal, as prescribed under Cap. 113.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a private limited company; a single subscriber share of €1.00 (issued by way of capital establishment) suffices. No escrow account or bank deposit is legally required at incorporation. Non-resident shareholders may own 100%; capital may be fully deferred, save that the Waste Management Permit and bank LC/TT facilities will typically demand evidenced working capital commensurate with the contemplated scrap tonnage.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The incorporation of the Company under Cyprus Companies Law, Cap. 113, with registered office in Nicosia, is ratified. (2) The allotment of 100 Ordinary Shares of €1.00 each is approved and issued to subscribers per the Register of Members. (3) The Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted as the governing instrument. (4) [First Director Name] is appointed first Director, and [Secretary Name] is appointed Secretary, each to serve until the first Annual General Meeting. (5) Directors are authorized to open bank accounts, appoint auditors, register for VAT and Social Insurance, and obtain the Waste Management Permit and municipal trade license.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DRCORO e-Companies portal, Name Reservation Module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the e-Companies portal, select 'Name Reservation', enter up to three proposed names in priority order, each incorporating the suffix 'Limited'. The system performs an automated cross-check against the Corporate Registry index and reserved names list. Upon acceptance, pay the applicable fee online; the Registrar then issues an electronic Name Approval Certificate reserving the name for a non-extendable period of six months. The English name and any transliterated Greek name must both be consistent with the ISIC 4669 object of the company.
required_dossiers: Three proposed corporate names in priority order
Passport copy and proof of residential address of each proposed shareholder and director
Corporate Registry search result confirming no conflicting registered name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on grounds of identity or similarity, file a fresh application with alternative names immediately, or submit an administrative objection to the Registrar under Cap. 113 s. 12 supported by a letter of consent from any prior holder of a similar name and a debenchmarkable trademark search report. A refusal may also be appealed to the District Court of Nicosia within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Certified Public Accountant or Advocate (as filing agent) in conjunction with a Cyprus Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association on the DRCORO standard HE-template, incorporating the corporate name, registered office clause in Nicosia, an object clause specifically covering 'wholesale trading, brokering and physical consignment of metal waste and scrap, including shredded non-ferrous copper wire (ISIC 4669)', the authorised share capital of €5,000 divided into 5,000 ordinary shares of €1.00, and restrictions on public offer consistent with private limited status. Each subscriber and the appointed director/secretary must initial every page and sign the attestation page in person before the Notary Public, who will certify the signatures and affix the notarial seal. The notarised bundle is then released for e-filing.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association
Articles of Association
Consent to Act as First Director (signed before a witness)
Consent to Act as Company Secretary
Notarially certified passport copies of subscribers and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should DRCORO query the notarization or object clause, the appointed advocate rectifies the affected pages, re-executes them before the same Notary Public, and re-submits via the portal typically within three business days; a fee of €40 (if any) is re-charged to the client, with the original statutory filing fee retained by DRCORO.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DRCORO one-stop shop, e-Companies electronic filing window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the notarized M&AA and all statutory consents to the DRCORO e-Companies portal. Enter the particulars of the registered office, directors, secretary, and the authenticated share allotment (100 shares of €1.00 each issued to the subscribers). Pay the €263 (approx. USD 285) incorporation fee by card or SEPA transfer. The Registrar, after verifying compliance with Cap. 113 s. 5, issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the unique Company Registration Number in the HE[XXXX] series, and automatically uploads the founding documents to the Companies Registry file. This certificate is the conclusive birth certificate of the corporate person.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name Approval Certificate (issued in Step 1)
Consents to act as Director and Secretary
Evidence of registered office address in Cyprus (leased premises or registered agent confirmation)
Subscriber statement (Form IR-1) confirming share allotment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is placed in query, the registered agent lodges a correction via the electronic rectification module within five working days. Failure to issue the certificate within fourteen working days triggers a duty on DRCORO to issue a written reason; refusal of incorporation is appealable to the District Court of Nicosia under Cap. 113 s. 10 within 30 days of written refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, Social Insurance and EORI Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cyprus Tax Department, Customs Department, Social Insurance Services (coordinated through the DRCORO one-stop shop)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The one-stop shop route automatically registers the newly incorporated company with the Cyprus Tax Department for corporate income tax and issues a Tax Identification Code (TIC). Separately file an electronic VAT application (TFC 101) because the projected turnover of scrap metal consignment is expected to exceed the €15,600 registration threshold; trading in eligible 'green' scrap metals may be zero-rated for VAT, and the company must elect the reverse-charge or margin scheme as applicable. Simultaneously obtain an Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number from the Customs Department for cross-border exports of shredded copper wire, and register as an employer with the Cyprus Social Insurance Services. A separate health and safety notification to the Department of Labour Inspection is required under Step 5 licensing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and M&AA
Director and shareholder passports and proof of residence
Registered office lease agreement or service address confirmation
Business plan / turnover projection for the recycling consignment model
Bank account details (or pending bank confirmation) for VAT refunds
Completed TFC 101, EORI application and social insurance registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For a delayed VAT registration, the applicant may submit a formal follow-up via the Tax Department's 'Registration Service' online ticket; if registration is not completed within 30 days, a written application to the Commissioner of Taxation for a binding decision will resolve the issue. Late EORI allocation can be escalated to the Customs ICON system helpdesk; refusal of EORI is appealable to the Director of Customs under the Customs Code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance, Stamping and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Secretary, Directors, and the District Stamp Office of the Republic
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the inaugural Board meeting and adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution recorded in the statutory minutes book. Issue numbered share certificates for the subscribed shares, create the Register of Members, Register of Directors and Register of Charges, and affix the company seal (optional). File the share capital with the Revenue Department for stamp duty purposes: the duty is €0.20 per €100 of authorised capital, capped at €20,000, and must be paid within 30 days of incorporation. Finally, open the dedicated corporate bank account under a KYC‑compliant package, electing Documentary LC and Swift TT as payment rails; the bank will require a UBO declaration identifying the ultimate beneficial owner(s) and will apply enhanced due diligence because the scrap-metal trading sector is classified as Medium-Risk under Cyprus AML Law 188(I)/2007.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the First Board Meeting
Share certificates and share register
Statutory registers (Members, Directors, Secretaries, Charges)
Stamp duty assessment form and receipt of payment
Corporate bank account application file including EDD questionnaire (source of funds and forecast flows of copper scrap trade)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late stamping attracts penalties of 10% (up to 6 months) and 20% (thereafter); an application to the Collector of Stamp Duty for remission upon proof of reasonable cause will regularize the matter. If a bank rejects the account application as a result of AML risk classification, the company may re-apply to a second-tier bank supporting metals trading, or submit a compliance remediation to the bank's MLRO with a fuller licence and EIA documentation package from Stage 2 licensing below.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Environment, Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment (Waste Management Unit) jointly with the Nicosia–Limassol Municipal Licensing Boards; export consignments additionally controlled by the Customs Department.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Waste Management Permit for non-hazardous metal waste dealing and brokering (issued under Law 185(I)/2011) and Municipal Business Operating License covering the physical storage and consignment warehouse for shredded scrap copper wire.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment, Republic of Cyprus
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration tier (Category N1 Waste Dealer/Broker) — full EIA Report is not required because the operation is limited to storage and dry physical consignment of non-hazardous shredded copper wire. A site Waste Management Plan, a registration dossier with the Department's Waste Registry and a zero-discharge commitment are mandated; a Full EIA (Category 9(a) Annex I, unless exempted) becomes necessary only if a mechanical shredding or sorting installation with >100 tonnes/day throughput is later added.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater is permissible from pure trading/storage operations; stormwater run-off must be captured and passed through oil/particulate separators before any discharge into municipal sewers, meeting pH 6.0–9.5, BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, TSS ≤ 60 mg/L under Cyprus Water Pollution Control Law (106(I)/2002). No VOC thresholds apply to metallic scrap; fugitive dust must be suppressed with water spraying and maintained below 5 mg/m³ at the site boundary per EU BREF Waste Treatment (2018). All scrap received and shipped must be weighed on a certified weighbridge, and outflow records must match Customs export declarations, with transboundary shipments of copper waste complying with EU Waste Shipment Regulation (EC) 1013/2006.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Cyprus Fire Service (Fire Prevention Law 75(I)/2004) verifying extinguishers, emergency exits and segregation of non-combustible metals; structural loading certificate from a registered civil engineer for racking and storage loads on the warehouse slab; occupational safety clearance from the Department of Labour Inspection under the Safety and Health at Work Law (158(I)/2005), including PPE provision, first-aid training and a written risk assessment; Civil Defense notification for the premises as prescribed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Tax Department of the Republic of Cyprus (Τμήμα Φορολογίας) — TaxisNet portal: https://taxportal.mof.gov.cy; customs and export controls by the Department of Customs and Excise (Τμήμα Τελωνείων).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Cyprus Private Limited Company (HE77) is automatically registered for income tax upon incorporation and obtains an 8-digit Tax Identification Number (TIN) coinciding with the company registration number. Before commencing taxable activity, the company or its appointed tax representative files Form E.F.V. 101 with the VAT Service of the Tax Department, attaching the certificate of incorporation, articles of association, registered office certificate, and director identification. The VAT number is issued in the format 'CY' + 8 digits + check digit. For physical consignment exports, the company must additionally obtain an EORI (Economic Operators Registration and Identification) number from the Customs and Excise Department.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — a Cyprus Ltd is a separate corporate taxpayer assessed at 12.5% on worldwide income; no pass-through or fiscal transparency classification exists. Participation exemption protects non-Cyprus dividend and permanent establishment income; the jurisdiction is Unitary_National with no sub-tax distinctions; non-resident ownership is fully permitted without affecting tax classification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is available under Cyprus law. Available statutory elections: (i) group relief consolidation for 75%+ EU/EEA resident subsidiaries; (ii) VAT group registration under VAT Law s.31(1); (iii) Cyprus IP Box election (Prorights) based on substantive nexus under s.25B; (iv) Notional Interest Deduction (NID) election on qualifying new equity; (v) tonnage tax election for qualifying vessels; (vi) deemed tax-residency determination is an evidenced-based management-and-control test rather than a formal election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (ΦΠΑ) under the Value Added Tax Law of 2000 (L.95(I)/2000), fully harmonized with EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 15,600 (mandatory registration if taxable turnover in any rolling 12-month period exceeds EUR 15,600; non-resident suppliers must register from the first taxable supply in Cyprus; higher thresholds apply to intra-Community distance sales of EUR 35,000 and intra-Community acquisitions of EUR 10,251.61).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: PEPPOL-compliant e-invoicing is mandatory for public-sector contracts (EU 2014/55/EU); B2B electronic invoicing is permitted but there is no real-time fiscal clearance, AI-based continuous control, or digital stamping regime currently in force in Cyprus. Periodic VIES recapitulative statements, Intrastat declarations, and the Cypriot Electronic Submission of Data (ESDE) framework must be filed electronically via TaxisNet. EU-level ViDA real-time digital reporting is not yet applicable to Cyprus and is expected only from 2030 onward.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to (i) direct exports and physical consignment of recycled scrap copper wire to non-EU destinations under VAT Law s.5(1)(a), provided the goods are dispatched to a third-country destination and the supplier obtains proof of export within 90 days from the date of supply; and (ii) intra-Community supplies under s.5(1)(b) where the buyer holds a valid EU VAT number and proof of intra-Community dispatch is secured within 5 months. Domestic Cyprus sales of copper scrap are excluded from the standard charge and are subject to the special reverse-charge rule under s.38A. The supplier must hold contractual evidence of risk transfer, freight terms (CIF/FOB/CIP), and foreign destination. Export refunds are claimable on each quarterly VAT return; excess credits are refundable through the Tax Department within 3 months of application.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Electronic Single Administrative Document) with EORI number validation
Bill of Lading (or CMR/Air Waybill) evidencing physical dispatch to the non-EU destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT confirmation proving receipt of proceeds from the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rated export claims on recycled metals are subject to heightened scrutiny by the Cyprus Tax Department and EU anti-MTIC metal fraud task forces. If the export evidence is missing, untimely, or commercially inconsistent, the supply is reclassified as taxable at 19% with retroactive assessments up to 7 years, statutory interest (currently 8.5% per annum on VAT), and administrative penalties of up to 200% of the tax deficiency. Fraudulent zero-rating, false customs declarations, or artificial round-tripping of scrap triggers criminal prosecution of directors under VAT Law s.45, punishable by fines and imprisonment, in addition to customs fraud penalties under the Customs Code and AML actions for suspicious cross-border metals payments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Cyprus (Kεντρική Τράπεζα της Κύπρου / Kentriki Trapeza tis Kyprou)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Cyprus, as a Eurozone member, applies full free movement of capital under EU Treaty provisions. Both current and capital account transactions are fully convertible absent general foreign-exchange restrictions. Profit remittance, dividend distribution, and capital repatriation are unrestricted, subject to standard corporate law requirements, tax clearance, and anti-money laundering compliance. The Euro is legal tender and all corporate treasury obligations can be settled in EUR or any freely traded currency. Practical hurdles arise only from enhanced due diligence for high-risk jurisdictions or sanctions screening, not from convertibility limitations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion of export receipts exists under Cypriot law. Export proceeds may be retained in foreign currency accounts with authorized banks, used for maritime or trade disbursements, or transferred offshore without central-bank approval. However, all cross-border payments above statistical reporting thresholds must be reported to the Central Bank of Cyprus for balance-of-payments compilation, and invoice/packing documentation must evidence the underlying physical consignment of recycled copper wire.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Cyprus Public Company Ltd

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: EU-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and Payment Institutions passported into Cyprus may be considered viable for ancillary treasury rails such as virtual IBANs or payment initiation, but they are not authorized to hold capital escrow accounts or provide credit-linked trade settlement. Non-EU offshore digital EMIs cannot lawfully operate in Cyprus without an EU license or passport and are generally rejected for corporate account opening. Feasibility rating: Medium for EU-licensed EMI passporting; Low to Not Viable for offshore digital EMIs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Cypriot banks universally require at least one director, ultimate beneficial owner, or authorized signatory to attend an in-person onboarding interview. Remote video KYC is partially accepted only for low-risk corporate clients in EU transactional counterparts; for medium-risk scrap-trading mandates with cross-border physical consignment, a physical interview at the bank branch or via a Cyprus-based professional introducer is effectively mandatory. Remote opening is not available to shell structures or non-resident opaque ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner in high-risk or sanctioned-linked jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport and proof of address; corporate registry extracts with full chain of ownership; sworn source-of-wealth declaration; independent credit or background report from a recognized international banking due-diligence vendor; open-source sanctions and adverse-media screening results; audited financial statements for the ultimate parent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering suspicion due to scrap-metal pricing volatility or invoice mismatch
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized commercial invoices with HS codes and ISIC 4669 scope; independent pre-shipment survey and weight certificates from an ISO-certified assayer; original or certified copies of CMR / bills of lading / air waybills; customs entry/export declarations; proof of physical movement (port terminal receipts, container tracking); reconciliation between invoice value, weight, and applicable London Metal Exchange price benchmarks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained payment sources from third-party financing or offtaker prepayments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly executed purchase or offtake contracts; legal opinion on enforceability; board resolution approving the prepayment or financing structure; complete banking references from the remitting bank; know-your-customer file for the counterparty; funds-flow confirmation via SWIFT MT103 with stated purpose code and underlying contract reference.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border transactions through jurisdictions with weak AML frameworks
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive corporate file including license for scrap dealing (if required under local law); trade compliance manual and AML/CFT internal procedures; tax identification numbers and tax residence certificates; confirmation of absence of shell status; ongoing transaction monitoring rationale and periodically updated customer due diligence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital for the Cyprus Ltd is routed via SWIFT MT103 from the subscribing shareholder's corporate bank account to the company's Cyprus escrow account. The wire must carry the ECB/BoP purpose code 'Direct Investment – Equity Capital' (code 'EQ/DA') in the remittance instructions. The CBC-compliant verification package comprises: board resolution approving the share allotment; signed subscription agreement; share register update; negative confirmation of bearer or unregistered shares; source of funds evidence; bank account signatory interview; and a legal opinion if the investor is an offshore entity. Funds may be held in a blocked capital escrow account pending completion of KYC and registration of the share capital increase with the Cypriot Registrar of Companies.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for recycled copper wire consignments are cleared through: (i) SWIFT MT103/ MT202 for open-account telegraphic transfer payments from the buyer; (ii) Irrevocable Documentary Letters of Credit (LC) issued by the buyer's international bank, confirmed by a top-tier Cyprus or EU bank; or (iii) Documentary Collections (DP/DA) where buyer credit quality is acceptable. The LC must require presentation of clean-on-board ocean bills of lading, commercial invoice, independent quality/weight certificate, certificate of origin, and all permits required for importation of recycled copper. Payments are made to the Cyprus operating account set up with dual authorisation and automated sanctions screening. For safer stewardship, the seller should obtain a pre-export inspection certificate and use a sale contract governed by English law with arbitration.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD and EUR/CNY forward contracts maturing up to 12 months
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for emerging-market currencies with no deliverable settlement in Cyprus
Cross-currency swaps (EUR vs USD or EUR vs CNY) for trade-finance asset swaps
FX options (call and put) for transactional hedging under MiFID II ISDA documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form HE32) together with the directors' report and audited financial statements covering the statutory accounting period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DROCOR), Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver, Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Nicosia, Cyprus
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of incorporation for the first return; for subsequent years, within 42 days after the anniversary to which the previous annual return was made up; the annual return must cover the period ending on the incorporation anniversary in each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty escalates from EUR 25 (arrears up to one month) to EUR 400 (arrears exceeding two years); non-filing for two or more consecutive years may result in administrative strike-off under Section 327, Companies Law, Cap. 113; criminal fines may be imposed on the company and every officer in default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Company Levy (statutory annual fee of EUR 350 payable to the Registrar, operating as the Cypriot annual renewal and franchise-equivalent filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DROCOR) via the Cyprus Companies Registry electronic payment portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June of each calendar year (annual levy year: 1 January to 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late settlement attracts an additional EUR 50 surcharge per levy year; non-payment for two consecutive years exposes the company to administrative strike-off without a court proceeding; restoration requires payment of arrears, surcharges and a court restoration petition.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation Declaration updating the Beneficial Ownership Register and the electronic UBO filing held by the Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DROCOR), Beneficial Ownership Register portal (established under Anti-Money Laundering Law 188(I)/2007 and Companies Law, Cap. 113)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in the same filing cycle as the Annual Return; any change in direct or indirect beneficial ownership or shareholding must be filed within 14 days of the relevant transfer or event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm or update UBO details is a criminal offense committed by the company and every officer in default; administrative fines and daily default penalties apply, and persistent non-compliance may block issuance of certificates of good standing and trigger default registration notes.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Cyprus private limited company must appoint an auditor registered with the Institute of Certified Public Accountants of Cyprus (ICPAC) and file audited financial statements with the Annual Return. The statutory audit exemption applies only to companies satisfying at least two of three conditions in two consecutive financial years: balance-sheet total not exceeding EUR 350,000; net turnover not exceeding EUR 700,000; average employees not exceeding 10. The exemption is unavailable to public-interest entities, parent/subsidiary groups, and regulated credit or insurance undertakings. A cross-border scrap-copper trading company settling through documentary letters of credit and Swift T/T will exceed these thresholds and a full statutory audit is compulsory.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the European Union; statutory financial statements must give a true and fair view in accordance with Company Law, Cap. 113; IFRS for SMEs is permissible for qualifying small Cyprus companies without public accountability.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Register of Beneficial Owners must be physically maintained at the registered office of the Cyprus company. At each annual return cycle the company must reconcile the members' register with current share transfers, bank and payment documents and any nominee arrangements, and must confirm the resulting beneficial-ownership data in the Registrar's electronic UBO system. Any allotment, transfer of shares or variation of beneficial ownership must be recorded in the statutory registers and notified to the Registrar within 14 days; the annual confirmation must be completed before the Annual Return is submitted, and copies of share transfer forms must be archived with the corporate secretary.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (ledger of shares, transfers and allotments)
Minute Book of members' meetings and directors' proceedings
Register of Charges (mortgages, pledges and floating charges)
Register of Annual Returns and other statutory filings (Form HE32 archive)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,100 – USD 2,300 per annum for licensed registered-office address, local corporate secretary and registered agent services (excluding AML compliance officer, director and tax-preparer fees)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – USD 9,500 per annum for a full IFRS statutory audit of a private Cyprus trading company with cross-border documentary-credit transactions and commodity-grade inventory records

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: A flat 12.5% CIT applies to worldwide profits. Incentives materially lowering the effective CIT rate include: (a) Notional Interest Deduction (NID) on new equity subscribed in cash, capped at the taxable base; (b) IP Box regime exempting 80% of qualifying intangible-derived profits, producing an effective 2.5% rate on qualifying IP income; (c) exemption of capital gains on disposal of participating securities; (d) 55% exemption for dividends received from resident and non-resident subsidiaries; (e) 125% super-deduction for R&D expenditure; and (f) 20% enhanced deduction for capital expenditure on selected fixed assets. No sector-specific concession is granted for wholesale scrap or recycled non-ferrous metals trading, but the 12.5% flat rate itself remains the headline benefit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IR4 - Corporation Tax Return, submitted electronically through the Cyprus Tax Department's Tax Portal (taxportal.mof.gov.cy, operated on the ARIADNE e-government platform).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return must be filed by the earlier of (i) 15 months after the end of the accounting period, or (ii) 31 December of the year following the end of the accounting period. For an accounting year ending 31 December 2024, the filing deadline is 31 December 2025.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: TIN, company registration number (HE77), legal name, registered office address, date of incorporation, and the accounting period covered.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Cyprus TIC (Tax Identification Code) and company registration number exactly as shown in ARIADNE; non-resident directors may sign digitally via the Tax Portal after enrolment, otherwise a local authorized officer must submit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business activity code and description; for this entity use ISIC 4669 'Wholesale of waste and scrap' with commercial detail 'cross-border physical consignment of shredded non-ferrous scrap'.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the ISIC v4 code and describe the physical intermediary model, noting that import/export documentary LC and Swift TT payment rails are the only settlement channels.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: IR4 - Part C, Box 8 (Audited Financial Statements)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attach the signed audited profit-and-loss account, balance sheet, and notes; figures must be EUR-denominated and consolidated if the entity has a subsidiary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Audited by a Cyprus-licensed auditor (FAR); if the parent is foreign, a signed group audit statement is still required on the IR4.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter net accounting profit before tax from the audited income statement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide income as computed under IFRS; foreign branch profits eligible for the Cyprus foreign branch exemption should be separately substantiated by a certificate of tax residence and foreign tax payment proof.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List non-deductible charges: penalties, entertainment excess, non-statutory provisions, and capital losses on current assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include transfer-pricing addbacks for interest paid on shareholder loans if thin-capitalization rules apply (30% EBITDA safe harbour for related-party interest).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: IR4 - Part F, Box 11 (Exempt / Deductible Income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct dividends received (55% exemption), exempt foreign PE income, notional interest deduction (NID) computed, and IP Box 80% exemption.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach supporting schedules; dividend relief is available only for participating subsidiaries. NID computation must follow the statutory WACC-based reference rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: IR4 - Part G, Box 12 (Tax Loss Relief)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare the amount of carried-forward tax losses utilized, limited to 5 years from the loss year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses are available to the same legal entity in Cyprus; a change of ownership of more than 50% within the loss carryforward window is acceptable but must be disclosed for year 3 onwards.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed as accounting profit adjusted by additions, deductions, and loss relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This box is the base for the 12.5% headline CIT computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Show CIT at 12.5% on chargeable income, foreign tax credits, provisional tax paid, and final balance payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offset only statutory foreign tax credits (not exceeding Cyprus tax attributable to that income) and include any advance provisional tax paid.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of all intercompany sales, purchases, financing, royalties, and bad debts; taxpayer must confirm whether an OECD-aligned comparability analysis exists.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Cyprus trading entity, list each foreign affiliate transaction for scrap purchases/sales, including pricing basis, volume, and payment terms; the Tax Department may require the full Local File within 30 days of a request.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an automatic penalty: EUR 100 for up to 2 months, EUR 250 for 2-4 months, EUR 500 for more than 4 months. Underpaid tax subsequently assessed carries an interest charge of 5% per annum from the due date and a surcharge of 10% if the taxpayer submits an amended return after formal assessment. Persistent non-filing may be prosecuted criminally under the Assessment and Collection of Taxes Law with fines and imprisonment up to 5 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Cyprus imposes no withholding tax on outbound dividends to non-resident shareholders; the special defence contribution on dividends for company payers has been abolished since 1 January 2021.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A Cyprus-resident company receiving inbound dividends applies for a Cyprus Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) electronically through the Tax Portal; the TRC is issued within days, then submitted to the source-country tax authority together with the applicable treaty-relief claim form (an original, apostilled and certified copy may additionally be required by certain jurisdictions). For inbound dividends into Cyprus, reliance on the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive and the DTA network (e.g., CN-CY DTA 5% on dividends for a 10%+ holding, 10% for portfolio holdings) is documented by providing the overseas payer with the TRC, the form for exemption (such as Form 10 or equivalent local certificate), and a declaration of beneficial ownership. For outbound distributions by the Cyprus company, no relief application is needed because the statutory withholding rate is zero; no DTA annex is required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: domestic WHT is 5% (on gross royalties for the use of intellectual property arising in Cyprus); this is reduced to 0% between associated companies of EU Member States under the EU Interest-Royalties Directive, and to 0-10% under most DTAs. Interest: statutory WHT on interest paid to non-residents is 0%, with limited exceptions for interest secured on Cyprus immovable property or from trading in Cyprus; DTA clauses generally provide 0-10% where a lender is treaty-resident. For the ISIC 4669 trading model, physical settlement cash flows are not subject to interest or royalty WHT because the income is derived from sales of goods.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory de-minimis exemption is codified; the Cyprus Tax Department operates a risk-based, request-driven transfer-pricing regime. Contemporaneous Local File and Master File are practically required where annual related-party goods turnover exceeds EUR 1,000,000, services or financial transactions exceed EUR 500,000, or where the Cypriot entity operates within an MNE group with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000 (the mandatory Country-by-Country Report threshold; the CBCR form is filed in Cyprus on ARIADNE together with notification).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Cyprus has no UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) code, but the doctrine operates indirectly through the Cyprus corporation residence test (management and control exercised in Cyprus), the IP Box nexus requirements, the ATAD-compliant interest limitation rule, and the 2017 administrative TP framework. For an ISIC 4669 recycled-scrap trader, substance is established by physical office premises, locally resident directors engaged in procurement/logistics decisions, documented board minutes, bank accounts in Cyprus, and evidence that negotiation, risk assumption, and freight/logistics management are performed in Cyprus. Failure to demonstrate substance exposes the company to general anti-abuse rulings, recharacterization of profits, denial of NID and treaty benefits, and CFC attribution in shareholder jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting an IR4 that underreports scrap sales proceeds, fabricates purchase invoices for export VAT zero-rating, misclassifies taxable income as exempt dividend income, or conceals offshore bank accounts used for the collection of LC proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal conviction under the Cyprus Income Tax Law: fine of up to EUR 20,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 5 years; civil recovery of the underpaid tax plus a 10% assessment surcharge and 5% annual interest. The Cyprus Tax Department can also raise a jeopardy assessment with immediate collection measures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors who sign false returns or direct concealment are prosecuted as principals, with travel bans and sequestration orders issued under the Tax Collection Law. Upon conviction, automatic disqualification as director for up to 5 years applies; the director's personal bank accounts can be frozen under a foreign-asset investigation order.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Acting as a conduit for shredded scrap copper wire without performing customer due diligence on the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO), issuing or receiving invoices at artificially inflated/deflated unit prices to move value between jurisdictions, accepting settlement from unknown SPVs, or transacting through payment rails inconsistent with the disclosed trading model (e.g., personal bank transfers for a commercial LC shipment).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Venue: Cyprus AML Law 188(I)/2007, as amended by Law 15(I)/2020. Legal person exposed to criminal fines of up to EUR 1,000,000, publication of the sanction, suspension of the Cyprus VAT registration, and seizure of bank accounts; the financial institution is obligated to file a suspicious transaction report to MOKAS, triggering an asset freezing order. Repeat or systemic misconduct leads to an administrative penalty of EUR 500,000 and loss of the operating licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors knowingly involved in ML can be sentenced to imprisonment for up to 14 years and face confiscation orders under the Proceeds of Crime Law covering the company's assets. Directors found to have tolerated the conduct are individually liable for civil restitution to the repatriating creditor and subject to EU-wide travel bans in extradition proceedings.
